meaning: (Qal) to hang, hang to, cling to

elsewhere.note: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan…
My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
